summary: Add free-form Tag concept with many-to-many to Alert; add/remove tag endpoints, optional tag filter on GET /api/alerts, and expose tags in AlertResponse.
constraints: Max 10 tags per alert; each tag name 1-30 chars, non-whitespace.
Dedupe case-insensitively within an alert; reuse an existing Tag row (case-insensitive match) rather than creating duplicates.
DECISION: AlertResponse.Tags is List<string> of tag names, ordered ascending for deterministic output.

DECISION: Explicit join entity AlertTag (table AlertTags) per database-standards; PK on (AlertId, TagId); FK_AlertTags_Alerts, FK_AlertTags_Tags; unique IX_Tags_Name (SQL default CI collation gives case-insensitive uniqueness).
DECISION: Store Tag.Name as first-seen casing; matching/dedupe is case-insensitive.
POST returns updated AlertResponse (200) or 404 if alert missing; validation errors as RFC7807 (400).
DELETE returns 404 if the alert or the tag assignment does not exist; 204/200 on success.
GET tag filter composable with isActive, severity, date range, search; case-insensitive match.
Keep DB out of controller; route persistence through service -> repository (no EF in API business logic).
No SELECT *; eager-load Tags via Include for read paths that expose tags.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage on tag add (dedupe, max-10, length bounds), tag remove (404 paths), and tag filter composition on GET.
>=90% line coverage on changed service/repository/mapping code per coding-standards.
